name: Freezing Snow
body:
School conjuration (creation) [cold, water]; Level druid 1, ranger 1, shaman 1, sorcerer/wizard 1, witch 1

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, M (a handful of chalk)/DF

EFFECT

Range medium (100 ft. + 10 ft./level)
Area 20-ft. radius
Duration 1 round/level
Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance no

You cause sheets of freezing snow to spread over the ground in the area of effect. This layer of snow is 1 foot deep and constantly shifts and churns, transforming the ground in the area into difficult terrain. The snow deals 1d4 points of cold damage to any creature that ends its turn in contact with the ground within the area of effect. At the end of the duration, the snow vanishes, leaving no after-effects (other than damage dealt).
